title: Marked increase in gastric acid secretory capacity after omeprazole treatment
authors: Waldum HL, Arnestad JS, Brenna E, Eide I, Syversen U, Sandvik AK
followUp: 90 days of omeprazole and 14 days after stopping
population: Patients with reflux oesophagitis treated with omeprazole 40 mg daily
funder: Not read: PMC holds page scans of the article only, and the PDF could not be retrieved.
result: Meal-stimulated gastrin release rose during omeprazole, with increased ECL-cell mass (oxyntic histamine and chromogranin A) and serum chromogranin A. Fourteen days after stopping, basal acid secretion was significantly higher and pentagastrin-stimulated acid secretion about 50% higher than before treatment.
